title: SKYTTA / HOKKSUND/AULI sliding door
description: SKYTTA / HOKKSUND/AULI sliding door, aluminum/high-gloss light gray mirror glass, 1181/2x801/2" 10-year Limited Warranty. Read about the terms in the Limited Warranty brochure.
features: Two people are needed to assemble this solution. Installing sliding doors can require a professional carpenter. We recommend that you always use our Assembly service when buying SKYTTA.
It’s possible to mount the doors even if they slightly overlap. However, we don´t recommend this if you use transparent panels since the overlap will show when the doors are closed.
SKYTTA door frames and rails are available in white, black and aluminum.
You can open either 1 door at a time, or slide 2 doors behind the 3rd.
In order for the sliding doors to function properly, it's very important that your floor and ceiling are completely even and aligned.
Product is possible to recycle or use for energy recovery, if available in your community.
